requirements: City environment
Visible heat indicators (sun, heat waves)
Heat haze / people fanning themselves
AI technology visible (robot, drone, smart sign)

category4_python.title: Python Game Development Competition
category4_python.brief: Build a Heat Wave Survival Pac-Man Game (Python / Pygame). Use prompt engineering and document your prompts.

steps.title: Task 1 — Build a Simple Python Maze
requirements: Open the starter code in Trinket and run it.
Design simple maze walls using rectangles to block movement.
Player must collide with maze boundaries.

steps.title: Task 2 — Create Game Assets (Heat Wave Theme)
requirements: Create cooling items (water bottle / ice cube / AC unit).
Create hazard items (sun / fire / lava tiles).
Use a Heat Wave theme for visuals.

steps.title: Task 3 — Add Scoring & Game Logic
requirements: Score increases when collecting cooling items.
Hazards reduce health or cause game over.
Win condition: all cooling items collected.

steps.title: Task 4 (Optional) — Bonus Challenge
requirements: Make hazards move continuously and randomly within the maze.

submission: A fully functional Python game file (.py)
A documented set of prompts used during development
